notes: Larkspur Silicon (doc 58 v1.1 §2, M78.1): an invented Ethash-ASIC start-up you can back in 2020Q2-Q4, and its two machines. Grades: [A]-[D] as doc 60; [D] = designed. The LK machines are kept out of machines.json on purpose: they appear in no buy menu and no bot's list, only through the Ventures screen, so a game that never touches the feature is byte-identical.

offer.note: Stake = share x the pitched budget, paid in thirds: the buy-in at joining, a call at tape-out and a call at first units (doc 49's shape). Dilute halves the stake; walk forfeits it.

milestones.note: Pitched dates. Real Ethash ASICs shipped late: Linzhi's Phoenix about 18 months [doc 60 §1].

slip.note: One draw per game (substream larkspur:slip) shifts first units and volume (and the tape-out) by 0, 1 or 2 quarters.

outcome.note: Drawn once per game at tape-out (substream larkspur:outcome); bounded by doc 60 §6's 20-30% of start-ups failing. Acquired pays 1.5 x paid-in, deposits refunded, no machines.

memory.note: [B] the DAG reached 5 GB on 17 Aug 2022; [A] the Merge was 15 Sep 2022. A backer with 20% or more picks LK-5 or LK-6 at the tape-out call; with 10% (or none) the founders pick LK-5. After its wall a unit mines Ethereum Classic automatically.

reservation.note: Reserved units are bought at the discounted price in the first two quarters of volume, the deposit (10% of the discounted price) credited against them; what is not bought by then lapses with its deposit. Everyone else buys at full price from the quarter after (volume + 2).

valuation.note: Before volume the stake is carried at paid-in (x0.8 once the E9 teaser has run and volume has not come). From volume to the Merge it is your share x units shipped x margin per unit (doc 58 §2.2's paid-in x units x margin / budget, which is the same thing for an undiluted stake); at the Merge it falls to 10% of that. It resolves into cash at Act I's end.

models.name: Larkspur LK-5
models.real_basis: An invented Ethash ASIC with 5 GB of memory (doc 58 §2.2)
models.why: Three times a Gen 2 rig's megahashes per watt, and it dies when the DAG passes 5 GB.

power_kw.source: designed: about 3x Gen 2's MH per W

models.price_source: designed [D]: 45% of Gen 2's 2021Q2 street price per MH (doc 58 §2.2)

models.name: Larkspur LK-6
models.real_basis: An invented Ethash ASIC with 6 GB of memory (doc 58 §2.2)
models.why: The same chip with more memory, for 25% more: it lasts until the Merge.

power_kw.source: designed: about 3x Gen 2's MH per W
